strings.ui.title: NEON CHRONICLE
strings.ui.job_scene_idle: Pick a job to watch it here
strings.ui.minigame_bonus: The better you do, the more credits and XP this round gives, up to +{pct}%. Time stops while you play.
strings.minigame.hacking.help: Pick the firewall codes in the order shown. Start in the first row, then pick within the chosen code's column, then its row, switching between columns and rows. Complete the sequence before the buffer fills. Higher Hacking gives a bigger buffer.
strings.minigame.courier.help: Carry the package from the left to the square drop-off on the right. Each time you move, the red pursuers move one step up or down. You are caught if you share or swap squares with one. Move with the arrow keys, by clicking a neighboring square, or with the buttons. Higher Negotiation gives you more steps.
strings.minigame.mercenary.help: Enemies pop up one at a time in the four windows. Shoot before they fire back by clicking the window or pressing its number key. Eight enemies come; your pay depends on how many you take down. Shooting an empty window costs a little. Higher Combat keeps enemies exposed longer.
strings.ui.milestone_tip: Effect that grows at the next milestone. Applies to every job.
strings.ui.reset_confirm: Delete your save and start over?
strings.ui.rebirth_summary: You lived {age} as a {job} and earned {earned} credits. As your body fell, the sync sent part of this life's memories back to your mind copy.
strings.ui.upgrades_note: Memories that survived the sync improve your mind copy.
strings.ui.layout_rows: Swap the Jobs/Body row and the On the job/Log row
strings.ui.layout_columns: Swap the Implants column and the other panels
strings.log.awaken: Life {life}: you wake up in a new {body} at the back-alley clinic. Pick a job.
strings.log.awaken_first: Life {life}: you wake up at the back-alley clinic. Mio, the street doctor, says, "If you need work, Jin will set you up." Pick a job.
strings.log.job: Jin, the fixer, set you up with work as a {job}.
strings.log.death: Your body broke down. Memory points +{points}
strings.job.courier.name: Courier
strings.job.courier.desc: Run packages through the alleys of the Undercity. Safe but poorly paid. Negotiation raises pay.
strings.job.hacker.name: Hacker
strings.job.hacker.desc: Dive into corporate networks and sell the stolen data on the black market. Hacking raises pay.
strings.job.mercenary.name: Mercenary
strings.job.mercenary.desc: Take on the dirty work of corporate turf wars with a gun. Big pay, but your body wears out fast.
strings.skill.hacking.name: Hacking
strings.skill.hacking.voice: Your skill is one step short of a working method.
strings.skill.combat.name: Combat
strings.skill.combat.desc: Raises Mercenary pay and slightly slows body decay.
strings.skill.combat.voice: With those arms? Your bones will break first.
strings.skill.negotiation.name: Negotiation
strings.skill.negotiation.desc: Raises Courier pay and slightly raises all income.
strings.skill.negotiation.voice: Not enough practice yet to talk your way through this one.
strings.implant.neural_chip.name: Neural accelerator
strings.implant.bone_frame.name: Reinforced skeleton
strings.implant.credit_spoofer.name: Credit score spoofer
strings.implant.credit_spoofer.desc: Income +50%. Installed in your net identity, not your body, so it stays after rebirth.
strings.upgrade.echo.name: Echoes of memory
strings.upgrade.contacts.name: Black market contacts
strings.upgrade.talent.name: Inherited talent
strings.upgrade.focus_hacking.name: Intrusion pattern
strings.upgrade.focus_combat.name: Combat pattern
strings.upgrade.focus_negotiation.name: Negotiation pattern
strings.upgrade.archive.name: Deep archive
strings.upgrade.archive.desc: Memory points at the end of a life +10%
strings.upgrade.advance.name: Advance arrangements
strings.upgrade.advance.desc: Credits at the start of a life +150
strings.upgrade.haggling.name: Haggling tricks
strings.ui.upgrade_taken: Locked: you took {name}. Choose again to take this
strings.event.odd_package.name: Odd Package
strings.event.odd_package.desc: Something inside the package is humming. The client only said: don't look inside.
strings.event.odd_package.fall: collapsed while delivering a suspicious package
strings.event.odd_package.deliver.name: Deliver it as is
strings.event.odd_package.deliver.result: You delivered the package. The man who took it was trembling a little.
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.name: Check it and raise the price
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.result: It was a corporate prototype. You got a bigger fee for keeping quiet.
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.voice: The client doesn't want it opened. That's worth money.
strings.event.odd_package.dump.name: Dump it in an alley
strings.event.odd_package.dump.result: You dumped the package and ran. You had to pay back the advance.
strings.event.gang_toll.name: Alley Toll
strings.event.gang_toll.desc: In the alley shortcut, a pack of thugs the locals scorn as ticks and hyenas blocks the way. They want a toll.
strings.event.gang_toll.fall: went down under a beating from alley thugs
strings.event.gang_toll.pay.name: Pay
strings.event.gang_toll.pay.result: You paid the toll and got through.
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.name: Talk your way through
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.result: You dropped the right name, and the thugs stepped aside.
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.voice: Why pay? Their kind fold at the right name.
strings.event.gang_toll.run.name: Run for it
strings.event.gang_toll.run.result: You took a few hits, but made it through.
strings.event.corp_trace.name: Corporate Trace
strings.event.corp_trace.desc: Corporate security has started tracing your connection. They will find you soon.
strings.event.corp_trace.fall: fell when a corporate counterattack burned the nerves
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.name: Cut the connection
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.result: You cut the connection and lost the data you were stealing.
strings.event.corp_trace.push.name: Grab the data anyway
strings.event.corp_trace.push.result: You got the data, but the counterattack burned your nerves.
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.name: Trace them back
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.result: You followed the trace back and opened another corporate vault.
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.voice: Only one trace route. Following it back is easy.
strings.event.rival_hacker.name: Rival Hacker
strings.event.rival_hacker.desc: An unknown hacker challenges you: who can break the firewall first?
strings.event.rival_hacker.decline.name: Ignore it
strings.event.rival_hacker.decline.result: You ignored the challenge and kept working.
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.name: Accept
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.result: You won. The rival shared a few tricks before leaving.
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.voice: Three habits in their firewall. No reason to lose.
strings.event.betrayal.name: Betrayal
strings.event.betrayal.desc: On the way back from a job, your partner points a gun at you to keep the whole payment.
strings.event.betrayal.fall: was shot down by a traitor
strings.event.betrayal.fight.name: Shoot it out
strings.event.betrayal.fight.result: You won the shootout and kept the payment. The bullets left their marks.
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.name: Hand over the payment
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.result: You handed over the payment and walked away.
strings.event.betrayal.talk.name: Talk them down
strings.event.betrayal.talk.result: You told them what the client was really after. They lowered the gun.
strings.event.betrayal.talk.voice: Finger's not on the trigger yet. That face will still listen.
strings.event.ambush.name: Ambush
strings.event.ambush.desc: Corporate soldiers are waiting in ambush just before the target.
strings.event.ambush.retreat.name: Fall back
strings.event.ambush.charge.name: Break through
strings.event.ambush.charge.result: You broke through and took their gear as well.
strings.event.ambush.charge.voice: Plenty of them, but they're scared. Go straight through.
strings.event.medicine.name: Medicine Run
strings.event.medicine.desc: An old food-stall owner asks you to take medicine to a grandchild with a fever. It suppresses rejection of Waldeck Prosthetics implants, and would fetch a high price on the black market. The grandchild lives at the far end of the Undercity.
strings.event.medicine.fall: fell carrying medicine into the depths of the Undercity
strings.event.medicine.deliver.name: Take it to the grandchild
strings.event.medicine.deliver.result: You carried the medicine to the far end of the Undercity. The owner couldn't pay much, but you hear the fever broke.
strings.event.medicine.deliver.chronicle: carried medicine to a stall owner's grandchild
strings.event.medicine.resell.name: Sell it on the black market
strings.event.medicine.resell.result: The medicine sold well on the black market. You've stayed away from that stall ever since.
strings.event.medicine.resell.chronicle: sold a stall owner's medicine on the black market
strings.event.medicine.refuse.name: Refuse
strings.event.medicine.refuse.result: You turned it down as not worth it. The owner nodded without a word.
strings.event.medicine.refuse.chronicle: turned down a stall owner's request
strings.event.ration_run.name: Ration Run
strings.event.ration_run.desc: You are hauling crates of Lindholm Foods synthetic rations to food stalls in the Undercity. Just past the bridge, hungry residents crowd around your cart.
strings.event.ration_run.fall: fell surrounded by residents while hauling ration crates
strings.event.ration_run.push.name: Push through
strings.event.ration_run.push.result: You shoved the residents aside and delivered every crate to the stalls. Your arms are covered in scratches.
strings.event.ration_run.push.chronicle: shoved hungry residents aside to deliver ration crates
strings.event.ration_run.share.name: Hand out a crate
strings.event.ration_run.share.result: You opened one crate and handed it out to the residents. You paid for the missing crate out of your own cut.
strings.event.ration_run.share.chronicle: handed out a crate of rations to the residents
strings.event.ration_run.detour.name: Turn back and go around
strings.event.ration_run.detour.result: You went around by another bridge and made the delivery. Your pay was docked for being late.
strings.event.ration_run.detour.chronicle: took the long way around to deliver ration crates
strings.event.protection_run.name: Protection Run
strings.event.protection_run.desc: The Zander Family asked you to carry the protection money the Stall Union collected to the Back Alleys. The bag is heavier than you expected. An old man from the Stall Union muttered that the amount is too high this month.
strings.event.protection_run.fall: fell while running from the Zander Family with their protection money
strings.event.protection_run.deliver.name: Deliver it to the Family
strings.event.protection_run.deliver.result: You delivered the bag to the Family in the Back Alleys as it was and took your carrying fee.
strings.event.protection_run.deliver.chronicle: delivered the Stall Union's protection money to the Zander Family
strings.event.protection_run.return.name: Return some to the Union
strings.event.protection_run.return.result: You took out the excess and returned it to the Stall Union. You told the Family this was all that came in. Your fee was cut to make up the gap.
strings.event.protection_run.return.chronicle: returned part of the excess protection money to the Stall Union
strings.event.protection_run.pocket.name: Run off with it
strings.event.protection_run.pocket.result: You ran with the bag. You took beating after beating before you shook off the Family's men.
strings.event.protection_run.pocket.chronicle: ran off with the Zander Family's protection money
strings.event.old_plaque.name: The Old Plaque
strings.event.old_plaque.desc: You are waiting at the foot of Hagen Bridge for a load of synthetic rations. A rusted plaque is bolted to the base of the railing. You can make out: "Hagen Bridge. Built by city engineer Hagen from the plans of the master engineer Olsen." Even a scrap of metal like this sells on the Black Market.
strings.event.old_plaque.fall: fell to a Montfort Security guard while prying a plaque off a bridge
strings.event.old_plaque.pry.name: Pry it off and sell it
strings.event.old_plaque.pry.result: You pried off the plaque and sold it on the Black Market. A Montfort Security guard caught you at it, and you took a beating getting away.
strings.event.old_plaque.pry.chronicle: pried the plaque off Hagen Bridge and sold it
strings.event.old_plaque.ask.name: Ask an old stall keeper
strings.event.old_plaque.ask.result: After picking up the load, you asked an old stall keeper on Food Stall Street about the plaque. From what the old man's parents told him, the city was once run by a city government, and its engineers built the bridges. He talked for a long time.
strings.event.old_plaque.ask.chronicle: asked an old stall keeper where the Hagen Bridge plaque came from
strings.event.old_plaque.leave.name: Leave it
strings.event.old_plaque.leave.result: You left the plaque alone, took the load, and hurried on.
strings.event.old_plaque.leave.chronicle: left the Hagen Bridge plaque where it was
strings.event.data_buyer.name: Black Market Buyer
strings.event.data_buyer.desc: You bring blueprints for a new Yomi Systems chip to the black market. The Waldeck Prosthetics buyer says "Yomi's soldiers are hunting for these" and tries to beat down the price.
strings.event.data_buyer.sell.name: Take the offer
strings.event.data_buyer.sell.result: You sold them cheap and left the market fast.
strings.event.data_buyer.sell.chronicle: sold stolen blueprints cheap to a Waldeck Prosthetics buyer
strings.event.data_buyer.shop.name: Find another buyer
strings.event.data_buyer.shop.result: Deep in the market, you found a buyer from another corporation. The blueprints went for twice the price.
strings.event.data_buyer.shop.voice: A buyer who haggles this hard hates competition.
strings.event.data_buyer.shop.chronicle: sold stolen blueprints high deep in the market
strings.event.data_buyer.leak.name: Leak them on the city net
strings.event.data_buyer.leak.result: Instead of selling, you leaked the blueprints on the city net. By morning, repair shops in the Undercity were building the same chip.
strings.event.data_buyer.leak.chronicle: leaked stolen blueprints on the city net
strings.event.substation.name: Substation Grab
strings.event.substation.desc: Hired by Waldeck Prosthetics, you seized a Yomi Systems substation on the edge of the Corporate District. Your orders are to cut the power beyond it. Cut it, and the Undercity across the bridge goes dark too.
strings.event.substation.fall: was shot by Yomi Systems soldiers while restoring power to the Undercity
strings.event.substation.cut.name: Cut it as ordered
strings.event.substation.cut.result: You cut the power and took your pay. Across the bridge, the lights of the Undercity went out all at once.
strings.event.substation.cut.chronicle: cut the power and left the Undercity dark
strings.event.substation.restore.name: Restore the Undercity's power
strings.event.substation.restore.result: Trading fire with the soldiers who rushed in, you restored power to the Undercity alone. There was no pay.
strings.event.substation.restore.chronicle: restored the Undercity's power under fire
strings.event.city_blueprints.name: City blueprints
strings.event.city_blueprints.desc: A data buyer asks you to decrypt a copy of an old archive. It was thrown out when city hall closed, and it holds the blueprints for the Olsen and Villard bridges. Handwritten notes remain in the margins.
strings.event.city_blueprints.sell.name: Sell it as is
strings.event.city_blueprints.sell.result: You sold the copy to the buyer without looking inside.
strings.event.city_blueprints.read.name: Read the notes
strings.event.city_blueprints.read.result: You broke the encryption and read the margin notes. Villard wrote that he built his bridge without changing a single line of his master Olsen's drawing. A thick conduit runs under the bridge deck. You handed the copy over.
strings.event.city_blueprints.read.voice: Only the handwriting uses a different cipher. Worth reading.
strings.event.city_blueprints.read.chronicle: read an old engineer's notes on the city blueprints
strings.event.city_blueprints.wipe.name: Wipe it
strings.event.city_blueprints.wipe.result: Old drawings nobody needs, you thought, and wiped the copy. The buyer shrugged.
strings.event.city_blueprints.wipe.chronicle: wiped a copy of the old city blueprints
strings.event.power_tap.name: Power Tap
strings.event.power_tap.desc: A repair shop owner on the stall street asked for your help. The tapped power line the street's food stalls run on is about to be caught by the Yomi Systems grid monitors. Rewrite the monitoring logs to hide it, and the line won't be cut.
strings.event.power_tap.fall: was nerve-burned by the grid monitors while hiding a tapped power line
strings.event.power_tap.hide.name: Rewrite the logs to hide it
strings.event.power_tap.hide.result: You rewrote the monitoring logs and hid the line. The countertrace burned deep inside your head. The repair shop owner scraped together what little money they had to pay you.
strings.event.power_tap.hide.voice: The monitoring log can be rewritten. The pain lasts seconds.
strings.event.power_tap.hide.chronicle: hid the stall street's tapped power line from the grid monitors
strings.event.power_tap.sell.name: Sell the line's location to Yomi Systems
strings.event.power_tap.sell.result: You sold the line's location to Yomi Systems and took your pay. That night, the lights on the stall street went out.
strings.event.power_tap.sell.chronicle: sold the location of the stall street's tapped power line to Yomi Systems
strings.event.power_tap.refuse.name: Refuse
strings.event.power_tap.refuse.result: You turned the job down and left the repair shop.
strings.event.power_tap.refuse.chronicle: turned down a job hiding a tapped power line
strings.event.fake_id.name: Fake Identity
strings.event.fake_id.desc: A young day laborer from Food Stall Street asked for your help. The fake identity they bought on the Black Market was caught by Yomi Systems monitors and erased, and Montfort Security turned them back at Hagen Bridge. Without an identity, they can't get to their job at the Lindholm Foods plant. If you make them a new one, they'll pay you what they have saved.
strings.event.fake_id.fall: was nerve-burned by Yomi Systems monitors while remaking a fake identity
strings.event.fake_id.remake.name: Remake it cheap
strings.event.fake_id.remake.result: You slipped past the monitors and remade their fake identity. The countertrace left an ache deep inside your head. The next morning, they crossed Hagen Bridge.
strings.event.fake_id.remake.voice: The erased ID's template is still there. Cheap to rebuild.
strings.event.fake_id.remake.chronicle: remade a young day laborer's fake identity for next to nothing
strings.event.fake_id.overcharge.name: Take all their savings
strings.event.fake_id.overcharge.result: You put together a cheap fake identity and took every credit they had saved. You didn't tell them it wouldn't last long.
strings.event.fake_id.overcharge.chronicle: took all a young day laborer's savings for a fake identity
strings.event.fake_id.refuse.name: Refuse
strings.event.fake_id.refuse.result: You turned them down. They muttered that they would have to go back to scavenging.
strings.event.fake_id.refuse.chronicle: turned down a day laborer who needed a fake identity
strings.event.debt_body.name: Collecting the Dead
strings.event.debt_body.desc: The Zander Family hired you to collect the body of a scavenger who died in debt, so you came to the Far End of the Undercity. If the body is sold to a back-alley doctor, the price of its parts will pay off the debt. In front of the house, the scavenger's younger sister begs you to let the Union's crematorium burn it whole.
strings.event.debt_body.fall: was attacked by the scavenger's friends while collecting a body for a debt
strings.event.debt_body.hand_over.name: Hand it over
strings.event.debt_body.hand_over.result: You carried the body to a back-alley doctor. A Family man counted the money and handed you your cut. The sister never said a word.
strings.event.debt_body.hand_over.chronicle: handed the body of a scavenger who died in debt to the Zander Family
strings.event.debt_body.leave.name: Leave the body
strings.event.debt_body.leave.result: You told the Family man the body had already been burned. He didn't believe you and threw a punch, but in the end he backed off. That night, smoke rose from the crematorium.
strings.event.debt_body.leave.voice: He's looking at money, not the body. One lie sends him home.
strings.event.debt_body.leave.chronicle: left a scavenger's body with his sister and fooled the Zander Family
strings.event.debt_body.refuse.name: Refuse
strings.event.debt_body.refuse.result: You turned the job down and left the Far End. The Family man said they would hire someone else.
strings.event.debt_body.refuse.chronicle: turned down collecting a dead scavenger's body
strings.chronicle.no_job: Lived without ever taking a job
strings.chronicle.end_decay: fell when the body gave out
strings.job.hacker.chronicle: Lived as a hacker diving into corporate networks
strings.job.mercenary.chronicle: Lived as a mercenary doing corporate dirty work
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.chronicle: found a corporate prototype in a package and raised the fee
strings.event.odd_package.dump.chronicle: dumped a suspicious package and ran
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.chronicle: talked past alley thugs with the right name
strings.event.gang_toll.run.chronicle: ran through alley thugs taking a few hits
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.chronicle: cut the connection when a corporation traced it
strings.event.corp_trace.push.chronicle: stole corporate data through a nerve-burning counterattack
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.chronicle: followed a corporate trace back and opened another vault
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.chronicle: beat a rival hacker to the firewall
strings.event.betrayal.fight.chronicle: shot it out with a traitor and kept the pay
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.chronicle: handed the pay to a traitor and walked away
strings.event.betrayal.talk.chronicle: talked down a comrade who drew a gun
strings.event.ambush.charge.chronicle: broke straight through a corporate ambush
strings.event.rei_1.name: A Hacker Gives a Name
strings.event.rei_1.desc: A voice reaches you from beyond the firewall on an unknown line. "I'm Rei. You're a subject too, aren't you? New body, same typing habits as last life."
strings.event.rei_1.listen.name: Hear Rei out
strings.event.rei_1.listen.result: Rei is a subject whose mind is used by the same program. Rei remembers past lives too.
strings.event.rei_1.listen.chronicle: traded names with Rei, a fellow subject
strings.event.rei_1.refuse.name: Cut the line
strings.event.rei_1.refuse.result: You cut the line. The voice that stayed in your ears sounded a little lonely.
strings.event.rei_1.refuse.chronicle: cut the line on Rei, who claimed to be a subject
strings.event.rei_2.name: Rei's Request
strings.event.rei_2.desc: Rei's voice comes again. Rei is a hacker who signed the same debt contract. Subjects have their memories of past lives sealed each time they wake, but Rei broke her own seal. She asks you to help steal the list of subjects from a corporate vault.
strings.event.rei_2.desc.listen: Rei's voice comes again. "Thanks for hearing me out last life. I'm a hacker who signed the debt contract too. Subjects have their past lives sealed away each time they wake, but I broke my seal myself. There's a list of subjects in a corporate vault. Help me pull it."
strings.event.rei_2.desc.refuse: Rei's voice comes again. "You cut me off last life, but let me ask once more. I'm a hacker who signed the debt contract too. Subjects have their past lives sealed away each time they wake, but I broke my seal myself. There's a list of subjects in a corporate vault. Help me pull it."
strings.event.rei_2.fall: fell to the corporate counterattack while pulling the list with Rei
strings.event.rei_2.help.name: Pull the list together
strings.event.rei_2.help.result: The two of you broke the firewall and pulled the list. It was all Undercity people who couldn't pay their debts, and your own number was on it.
strings.event.rei_2.help.voice: Two can break this firewall. One can't.
strings.event.rei_2.help.chronicle: pulled the list of subjects together with Rei
strings.event.rei_2.decline.name: Decline
strings.event.rei_2.decline.result: When you declined, Rei just said "I see" and cut the line.
strings.event.rei_2.decline.chronicle: turned down Rei's request to pull the list of subjects
strings.event.rei_3.name: Rei's Promise
strings.event.rei_3.desc: A short message from Rei arrives, asking whether you mean to go to the core.
strings.event.rei_3.desc.help: A short message from Rei arrives. "Thanks to the list, I found where the other subjects are. When the day comes that you go to the core, I'll open the door from the inside."
strings.event.rei_3.desc.decline: A short message from Rei arrives. "I pulled the list alone. If you mean to go to the core, I won't stop you."
strings.event.rei_3.promise.name: Promise to go together
strings.event.rei_3.promise.result: When you promised, Rei seemed to smile for the first time.
strings.event.rei_3.promise.chronicle: promised Rei to go to the core together
strings.event.rei_3.alone.name: Say you'll go alone
strings.event.rei_3.alone.result: You said you'd go alone. Rei only answered, "I'll remember that."
strings.event.rei_3.alone.chronicle: told Rei the core was a solo job
strings.event.jin_1.name: Jin's Warning
strings.event.jin_1.desc: Jin's voice comes over the comm. "Don't know your face. Corporate soldiers are watching the bridge ahead. Take the long way."
strings.event.jin_1.fall: ignored Jin's warning, crossed the bridge, and was shot down
strings.event.jin_1.heed.name: Take the long way
strings.event.jin_1.heed.result: You took the long way and delivered the package. The pay was a little less.
strings.event.jin_1.heed.chronicle: took Jin's warning and the long way around
strings.event.jin_1.ignore.name: Run the bridge
strings.event.jin_1.ignore.result: You ran the bridge. The bullet wound hurts, but you got full pay.
strings.event.jin_1.ignore.chronicle: brushed off Jin's warning and ran the bridge
strings.event.jin_2.name: Jin in Trouble
strings.event.jin_2.desc: You hear Jin is surrounded by debt collectors. Jin doesn't know you.
strings.event.jin_2.desc.heed: You hear Jin is surrounded by debt collectors. You remember how Jin's warning saved your life in your last body. Jin doesn't know you.
strings.event.jin_2.desc.ignore: You hear Jin is surrounded by debt collectors. You remember ignoring Jin's warning and getting shot in your last body. Jin doesn't know you.
strings.event.jin_2.fall: fell stepping in to save Jin from debt collectors
strings.event.jin_2.rescue.name: Go help
strings.event.jin_2.rescue.result: You drove off the debt collectors. Jin said, "Don't know your face, but I owe you one."
strings.event.jin_2.rescue.chronicle: saved Jin from a ring of debt collectors
strings.event.jin_2.leave.name: Look the other way
strings.event.jin_2.leave.result: You looked the other way and went back to work.
strings.event.jin_2.leave.chronicle: left Jin to the debt collectors
strings.event.jin_3.name: An Old Name
strings.event.jin_3.desc: After work, you end up in the same bar as Jin. Now you can recall the name Jin used to call you.
strings.event.jin_3.desc.rescue: After work, Jin offers to buy you a drink. Jin doesn't know you saved them from the debt collectors in your last body. Now you can recall the name Jin used to call you.
strings.event.jin_3.desc.leave: After work, you end up in the same bar as Jin. You remember leaving Jin to the debt collectors in your last body. Now you can recall the name Jin used to call you.
strings.event.jin_3.tell.name: Say your name
strings.event.jin_3.tell.result: When you said your name, Jin was silent for a long time. Then Jin only said, "You're alive."
strings.event.jin_3.silent.name: Keep quiet
strings.event.jin_3.silent.result: You kept your name to yourself. To the end, Jin thought you were a stranger.
strings.event.jin_3.silent.chronicle: kept an old name from Jin
strings.ui.fragment_next: Next fragment: end a life with {requires}
strings.ui.fragments_all: All memories have returned. You can breach the core server.
strings.log.ending: You reached the end of the story. Memory points +{points}
strings.log.away_gain: {age} passed while you were away. You earned {earned} credits. Memory point estimate +{points}

strings.challenge.one_job.name: One job

strings.challenge.no_safe.desc: In events where a choice with requirements is open, never pick one without requirements

strings.faction.zander.name: Zander Family
strings.faction.zander.desc: The gang that runs the back streets and the black market
strings.faction.union.name: Stall Union
strings.faction.union.desc: The residents' self-governing body of the stall street and the deep lower city
strings.faction.yomi.name: Yomi Systems
strings.faction.yomi.desc: The corporation that sells neural chips and the city's network backbone
strings.faction.valdeck.name: Valdeck Prosthetics
strings.faction.valdeck.desc: The corporation that builds and sells prosthetic bodies and implants
strings.event.gang_toll.zander_name.name: Drop the Zander name
strings.event.gang_toll.zander_name.result: You said you work for the Zander Family. The thugs looked away and cleared the way.
strings.event.gang_toll.zander_name.chronicle: passed the alley on the Zander name
strings.event.debt_body.union_pyre.name: Talk to the Stall Union
strings.event.debt_body.union_pyre.result: You brought it to the union elders. The union covered part of the debt from its ledger fund, and the Family man gave up the body. The sister saw her brother off at the union crematorium.
strings.event.debt_body.union_pyre.chronicle: sent a scavenger's body to the crematorium through the Stall Union
strings.event.data_buyer.valdeck_regular.name: Sell as a regular
strings.event.data_buyer.valdeck_regular.result: The buyer remembered your past deals and paid without haggling. Bring the next one too, he said.
strings.event.data_buyer.valdeck_regular.chronic: sold stolen blueprints to Valdeck as a regular, above the asking price
strings.event.power_tap.yomi_contact.name: Settle it with the watcher
strings.event.power_tap.yomi_contact.result: You called a Yomi Systems watcher who knows you by now. For a cut, he decided he never saw the logs. The repairer breathed again.
strings.event.power_tap.yomi_contact.chronicle: paid a Yomi Systems watcher to overlook a stolen power line
strings.event.feud_1.name: The union ledger
strings.event.feud_1.desc: The Stall Union asked you to carry its ledger to the meeting hall in the deep lower city. At a back-street corner, a Zander Family man blocks your way. The ledger shows how much every stall earns. He offers double your fee for it.
strings.event.feud_1.fall: went down protecting the union ledger from a Zander Family man
strings.event.feud_1.keep.name: Protect the ledger
strings.event.feud_1.keep.result: You ran the back street with the ledger in your arms and delivered it, bruised. The union elder bowed without a word.
strings.event.feud_1.keep.chronicle: protected the Stall Union ledger from the Zander Family
strings.event.feud_1.hand.name: Hand it over
strings.event.feud_1.hand.result: You gave him the ledger and took the money. You told the hall you lost it on the way.
strings.event.feud_1.hand.chronicle: handed the Stall Union ledger to the Zander Family
strings.event.feud_2.name: The protection hike
strings.event.feud_2.desc.keep: Having missed the ledger, the Zander Family announces it will double protection money on the stall street. The union has decided not to pay and is gathering people at the hall. The Family will come to collect tonight.
strings.event.feud_2.desc.hand: With every stall's earnings in the ledger, the Zander Family announces it will double protection money on the stall street. The union has decided not to pay and is gathering people at the hall. The Family will come to collect tonight.
strings.event.feud_2.desc: The Zander Family announces it will double protection money on the stall street. The union has decided not to pay and is gathering people at the hall. The Family will come to collect tonight.
strings.event.feud_2.fall: went down in the brawl on the night of the collection
strings.event.feud_2.side_union.name: Stand watch for the union
strings.event.feud_2.side_union.result: You stood watch at the mouth of the stall street with the union's young people. When the collectors came at midnight, you fought them off.
strings.event.feud_2.side_union.chronicle: stood watch for the Stall Union against the protection hike
strings.event.feud_2.side_zander.name: Collect for the Family
strings.event.feud_2.side_zander.result: You went stall to stall with the Family's collector. Once you knocked over one stall that refused, the rest paid in silence.
strings.event.feud_2.side_zander.chronicle: collected protection money for the Zander Family
strings.event.feud_2.stay_out.name: Stay out of it
strings.event.feud_2.stay_out.result: You kept away from the stall street that night. In the morning you heard stalls were overturned all along it.
strings.event.feud_2.stay_out.chronicle: stayed out of the stall street fight
strings.event.feud_3.name: Settling the stall street
strings.event.feud_3.desc.side_union: Driven off, the Zander Family asks the union to talk. The union elder wants you, who stood watch, at the table too.
strings.event.feud_3.desc.side_zander: Holding the stall street, the Zander Family calls a meeting to make the union accept the new rate. The Family man tells you, who collected for them, to take a seat.
strings.event.feud_3.desc.stay_out: The fight drags on. The union and the Family will meet, and someone asks you, who took no side, to stand between them.
strings.event.feud_3.desc: The Stall Union and the Zander Family will meet to settle the rate. Someone asks you to take a seat too.
strings.event.feud_3.union_end.name: Win the old rate back
strings.event.feud_3.union_end.result: You sat beside the union elder and made the Family go back to the old rate. The union paid you from its ledger fund.
strings.event.feud_3.union_end.chronicle: sat with the Stall Union and won back the old rate
strings.event.feud_3.zander_end.name: Force the Family's rate
strings.event.feud_3.zander_end.result: You stood behind the Family man and made the union swallow the doubled rate. On the way back, no one on the stall street met your eyes.
strings.event.feud_3.zander_end.chronicle: stood behind the Zander Family as the union swallowed a doubled rate
strings.event.feud_3.truce.name: Broker a truce
strings.event.feud_3.truce.result: You heard both sides and settled on a small raise. Neither was happy, but the lights came back on the stall street.
strings.event.feud_3.truce.voice: Neither side wants to lose. Raise it a little and both will settle.
strings.event.feud_3.truce.chronicle: brokered a truce between the Stall Union and the Zander Family
strings.event.feud_3.walk_away.name: Skip the table
strings.event.feud_3.walk_away.result: You did not take a seat. The fight died down on its own, without anyone's help.
strings.profile.zander.feud: Once tried to double protection money on the stall street and fought the Stall Union over it. Even after the rate was settled, the back streets look coldly on union people.
strings.profile.union.feud: When the Zander Family tried to double protection money, the union refused to pay and gathered people at the hall. The rate settled then is still in the ledger.
strings.ui.requires_identity: an identity that can cross the bridges
strings.ui.identity_buy: Buy a fake identity    {n} credits  Needed for mercenary work. Lost at the end of a life
strings.ui.identity_buy_kept: Buy a fake identity    {n} credits  Needed for mercenary work. You keep it once bought
strings.ui.identity_owned: You have a fake identity (lost at the end of this life)
strings.log.identity: You bought a fake identity on the black market. Now you can cross the bridges.
strings.body.standard.trait: Former owner: a stall seller who drove a hard bargain (Negotiation XP +20%)
strings.body.labor.trait: Former owner: a factory day laborer who never stopped working (Income +10%)
strings.body.combat.trait: Former owner: a Zander Family debt collector (Combat XP +30%)
strings.body.prototype.trait: Former owner: a lower-city hacker ruined by debt (Hacking XP +30%)
strings.event.owner_standard_1.name: Memory of a strange stall
strings.event.owner_standard_1.desc: Walking the stall street, your feet stop in front of a stall you have never seen. A memory surfaces with the feel of the hands: someone else haggling with customers here.
strings.event.owner_standard_1.follow.name: Follow the memory
strings.event.owner_standard_1.follow.result: Following the memory down the street, you reach a closed stall. The next owner says it belonged to a seller who drove a hard bargain.
strings.event.owner_standard_1.follow.chronicle: followed a seller's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_standard_1.shake.name: Shake it off
strings.event.owner_standard_1.shake.result: You pushed the strange memory away and went back to work.
strings.event.owner_standard_1.shake.chronicle: shook off a stranger's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_standard_2.name: The seller's end
strings.event.owner_standard_2.desc: The seller's memory surfaces again: the night they fell with a fever and died behind the stall, with no money for medicine. The Zander Family sold the body to a back-alley doctor.
strings.event.owner_standard_2.remember.name: Keep the memory
strings.event.owner_standard_2.remember.result: You decided to keep the seller's end as your own memory. Their quick tongue feels a little more like yours.
strings.event.owner_standard_2.remember.chronicl: kept the memory of the body's former owner, a seller
strings.event.owner_standard_2.let_go.name: Let it go
strings.event.owner_standard_2.let_go.result: No reason to carry a stranger's death, you thought, and let the memory go.
strings.event.owner_standard_2.let_go.chronicle: let go of the former owner's end
strings.event.owner_labor_1.name: Memory of factory mornings
strings.event.owner_labor_1.desc: On the bridge in the morning, you see the line of day laborers and your body starts toward it on its own. A memory surfaces of someone who cleaned the culture tanks at the Lindholm Foods plant.
strings.event.owner_labor_1.follow.name: Follow the memory
strings.event.owner_labor_1.follow.result: You asked the laborers about a man who cleaned the tanks. One had come every day for years, then one day stopped coming.
strings.event.owner_labor_1.follow.chronicle: followed a day laborer's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_labor_1.shake.name: Shake it off
strings.event.owner_labor_1.shake.result: You looked away from the line and went down the bridge.
strings.event.owner_labor_1.shake.chronicle: shook off a stranger's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_labor_2.name: The laborer's end
strings.event.owner_labor_2.desc: The laborer's memory surfaces again: his fake identity erased by Yomi Systems' watchers, unable to cross the bridges, wasting away in a lower-city shack.
strings.event.owner_labor_2.remember.name: Keep the memory
strings.event.owner_labor_2.remember.result: You decided to keep the laborer's end as your own memory. The way he braced to lift heavy loads settles into your body.
strings.event.owner_labor_2.remember.chronicle: kept the memory of the body's former owner, a day laborer
strings.event.owner_labor_2.let_go.name: Let it go
strings.event.owner_labor_2.let_go.result: No reason to carry a stranger's death, you thought, and let the memory go.
strings.event.owner_labor_2.let_go.chronicle: let go of the former owner's end
strings.event.owner_combat_1.name: Memory of collections
strings.event.owner_combat_1.desc: Hearing voices talk debt in a back street, your fists clench on their own. A memory surfaces of someone who stood at doorways collecting for the Zander Family.
strings.event.owner_combat_1.follow.name: Follow the memory
strings.event.owner_combat_1.follow.result: You visited a doorway from the memory. An old man went pale and shut the door. That house remembered the collector's face.
strings.event.owner_combat_1.follow.chronicle: followed a debt collector's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_combat_1.shake.name: Shake it off
strings.event.owner_combat_1.shake.result: You opened your fists and left the back street.
strings.event.owner_combat_1.shake.chronicle: shook off a stranger's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_combat_2.name: The collector's end
strings.event.owner_combat_2.desc: The collector's memory surfaces again: stabbed in an alley by a debtor's family, abandoned by the Family, the body sold to a back-alley doctor.
strings.event.owner_combat_2.remember.name: Keep the memory
strings.event.owner_combat_2.remember.result: You decided to keep the collector's end as your own memory. The feel for distance in a fight settles into your body.
strings.event.owner_combat_2.remember.chronicle: kept the memory of the body's former owner, a debt collector
strings.event.owner_combat_2.let_go.name: Let it go
strings.event.owner_combat_2.let_go.result: No reason to carry a stranger's death, you thought, and let the memory go.
strings.event.owner_combat_2.let_go.chronicle: let go of the former owner's end
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.name: Memory of someone's firewall
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.desc: The moment you jack in, an unfamiliar routine rises to your fingertips. Your body remembers how to break a firewall you never wrote. It is the memory of some lower-city hacker.
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.follow.name: Follow the memory
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.follow.result: Tracing the routine led you to an old handle on a black-market board: a hacker who vanished leaving debts behind.
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.follow.chronicle: followed a hacker's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.shake.name: Shake it off
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.shake.result: You pushed the routine away and kept working your own way.
strings.event.owner_prototype_1.shake.chronicle: shook off a stranger's memory left in the body
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.name: The hacker's end
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.desc: The hacker's memory surfaces again: offered a contract to erase their debt, they refused to sign and ran, and fell one night in a back street. You signed. This person did not.
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.remember.name: Keep the memory
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.remember.result: You decided to keep the end of the hacker who never signed as your own memory. The routine for breaking firewalls became yours.
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.remember.chronic: kept the memory of the body's former owner, a hacker
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.let_go.name: Let it go
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.let_go.result: No reason to carry a stranger's death, you thought, and let the memory go.
strings.event.owner_prototype_2.let_go.chronicle: let go of the former owner's end
strings.profile.owners.name: The bodies' former owners
strings.profile.owners.desc: The bodies Mio assembles carry nerves and arms taken from the lower city's dead. Each kind of body takes them from the same person, so when you wake in it, that person's memories sometimes surface.
strings.profile.owners.standard: The general-purpose body belonged to a stall seller who drove a hard bargain. They fell with a fever and died behind their stall with no money for medicine, and the Zander Family sold the body.
strings.profile.owners.labor: The labor body belonged to a day laborer who cleaned culture tanks at the Lindholm Foods plant. His fake identity was erased, he could no longer cross the bridges, and he wasted away in a lower-city shack.
strings.profile.owners.combat: The combat body belonged to a Zander Family debt collector. Stabbed by a debtor's family and abandoned by the Family, the body was sold to a back-alley doctor.
strings.profile.owners.prototype: The prototype body belonged to a lower-city hacker who refused to sign the debt contract, ran, and fell in a back street. Had they signed, they would have become a test subject like you.
strings.implant.pain_damper.name: Pain damper
strings.implant.market_eye.name: Market-reading eye
strings.implant.reflex_wiring.name: Reflex wiring
strings.implant.memory_cortex.name: Memory cortex
strings.event.mio_1.name: A night at the clinic
strings.event.mio_1.desc: Stopping by the clinic after work, you find lower-city patients lined up. Mio is stitching a scavenger kid's wound without charging. Mio asks you to hold the kid still, being short of hands.
strings.event.mio_1.fall: went down when a thrashing patient shoved you at the clinic
strings.event.mio_1.help.name: Lend a hand
strings.event.mio_1.help.result: Until dawn you held patients and carried medicine. When the last one left, Mio smiled: "The cut I keep from your pay buys their medicine too."
strings.event.mio_1.help.chronicle: helped at Mio's clinic until dawn
strings.event.mio_1.leave.name: Go home
strings.event.mio_1.leave.result: Not wanting to get in the way, you left the clinic.
strings.event.mio_1.leave.chronicle: turned down helping at Mio's clinic
strings.event.mio_2.name: Mio's hands
strings.event.mio_2.desc: At the clinic, Mio is sterilizing instruments. You realize Mio's hands move just like the technician's hands in the white room.
strings.event.mio_2.desc.help: At the clinic, Mio is sterilizing instruments. The hands you watched the night you held patients together move just like the technician's hands in the white room.
strings.event.mio_2.desc.leave: At the clinic, Mio is sterilizing instruments. You realize Mio's hands move just like the technician's hands in the white room.
strings.event.mio_2.ask.name: Ask about the white room
strings.event.mio_2.ask.result: Mio answered without stopping work. "We were the ones who pulled your mind out in that room. I quit partway. Before I left, I rewrote where your copy loads."
strings.event.mio_2.ask.chronicle: asked Mio about the white room
strings.event.mio_2.silent.name: Say nothing
strings.event.mio_2.silent.result: You asked nothing. Mio said nothing either, and put the instruments back on the shelf.
strings.event.mio_2.silent.chronicle: never asked Mio about the white room
strings.event.mio_3.name: Hunters at the clinic
strings.event.mio_3.desc: Yomi Systems' research division has begun tracing the rewritten load target. The trail is closing in on the back-alley clinic.
strings.event.mio_3.desc.ask: Yomi Systems' research division has begun tracing the rewritten load target. The trail is closing in on the back-alley clinic. "I may not be able to keep the place you wake up safe," Mio says.
strings.event.mio_3.desc.silent: Yomi Systems' research division has begun tracing the rewritten load target. The trail is closing in on the back-alley clinic. Mio silently starts packing the instruments.
strings.event.mio_3.fall: went down in a firefight with Yomi Systems soldiers at the clinic
strings.event.mio_3.cover.name: Divert the trace
strings.event.mio_3.cover.result: You slipped into the research division's trace and rewrote the load target record to point at an abandoned building. The backtrace burned, but the hunters headed for the ruin.
strings.event.mio_3.cover.voice: You can get into the trace. One rewritten record will do.
strings.event.mio_3.cover.chronicle: diverted the trace heading for Mio's clinic
strings.event.mio_3.guard.name: Guard the clinic
strings.event.mio_3.guard.result: You ambushed the soldiers searching for the clinic at the mouth of the back street. After you drove them off, Mio stitched you up without a word.
strings.event.mio_3.guard.voice: One way in. Wait there. Your fists still work.
strings.event.mio_3.guard.chronicle: drove off soldiers hunting for Mio's clinic
strings.event.mio_3.warn.name: Tell Mio to run
strings.event.mio_3.warn.result: "Run, like you let me run," you said. Mio laughed and shook their head. "Then where would you come back to?"
strings.profile.mio.clinic: At the clinic, Mio treats lower-city patients without charging. The cut Mio keeps from your pay buys not only body parts but their medicine too.
strings.profile.mio.chase: Yomi Systems' research division is tracing the rewritten load target to find the back-alley clinic. Even so, Mio will not leave it.
strings.event.grateful_stall.name: The stall keeper
strings.event.grateful_stall.desc: As you unload on the stall street, a kid minding a stall runs up. When they lay sick with fever, a courier they didn't know brought medicine. Your face is different, but you walk like that courier, the kid says, and holds out a packet of synthetic food.
strings.event.grateful_stall.accept.name: Take it
strings.event.grateful_stall.accept.result: You took the packet and ate beside the stall. The old owner bowed silently from the back.
strings.event.grateful_stall.accept.chronicle: took a food packet from a kid you brought medicine to in another body
strings.event.grateful_stall.decline.name: Say they have the wrong person
strings.event.grateful_stall.decline.result: You said they had the wrong person and handed the packet back. The kid tilted their head and went back to the stall.
strings.event.grateful_stall.decline.chronicle: told a kid you once helped in another body that they had the wrong person
strings.event.factory_payback.name: The factory kid
strings.event.factory_payback.desc: A message waits on a black-market board for your work handle. It is from the young man whose fake identity you remade. He now crosses the Hagen bridge to a factory and wants to pay back what he saved.
strings.event.factory_payback.take.name: Take it
strings.event.factory_payback.take.result: You met him at a stall and took the money. He rolled up the sleeve of his factory uniform and grinned.
strings.event.factory_payback.take.chronicle: took thanks money from a young man whose identity you remade in another body
strings.event.factory_payback.refuse.name: Refuse
strings.event.factory_payback.refuse.result: You left word that you didn't want the money. A union elder heard and came to thank you.
strings.event.factory_payback.refuse.chronicle: refused thanks from a young man whose identity you remade in another body
strings.event.dark_street.name: The dark stall street
strings.event.dark_street.desc: The lights on the stall street are still out. Since someone sold the location of the stolen power line to Yomi Systems last life, the repairer hasn't managed a new one. The repairer doesn't know you were the one who sold it.
strings.event.dark_street.fall: went down from a shock while rewiring the stolen power line
strings.event.dark_street.rewire.name: Rewire the line
strings.event.dark_street.rewire.result: Dodging the watchers, you and the repairer ran a new line. By night, the stall street was lit again.
strings.event.dark_street.rewire.voice: Two gaps in the monitoring grid. A line will fit.
strings.event.dark_street.rewire.chronicle: rewired the stolen line you sold in another body
strings.event.dark_street.walk_past.name: Walk past
strings.event.dark_street.walk_past.result: You hurried down the dark street.
strings.event.dark_street.walk_past.chronicle: walked past the dark street left by a line you sold in another body
strings.event.thief_hunt.name: The protection thief
strings.event.thief_hunt.desc: In a back street, Zander Family men are hunting the courier who ran off with a bag of protection money. Your face should be different, but one of them says you walk like that courier and stares.
strings.event.thief_hunt.bluff.name: Play dumb
strings.event.thief_hunt.bluff.result: You said you heard that courier fled across the bridge. The men clicked their tongues and headed for the bridge.
strings.event.thief_hunt.bluff.voice: They only suspect. They can't check. Play dumb.
strings.event.thief_hunt.bluff.chronicle: played dumb with the Zander Family about money you stole in another body
strings.event.thief_hunt.run.name: Run
strings.event.thief_hunt.run.result: You ran with the cargo. They caught you deep in an alley and landed a few blows before you broke away.
strings.event.thief_hunt.run.chronicle: was chased by the Zander Family over money you stole in another body
strings.event.thief_hunt.fall: went down when the Zander Family mistook you for the protection thief
strings.ui.calm: A breather (risky events are less likely)
strings.log.calm: After one close call after another, you can catch your breath for a while.
strings.rumor.zander_trusted.text: The young toughs in the Back Alley say word came down from the Family: hands off anyone who comes out of the clinic.
strings.rumor.zander_marked.text: Heard on the Black Market: the Family wants its people to remember the faces of anyone who comes out of the clinic.
strings.rumor.union_trusted.text: A stall cook laughed and said the Stall Union's stalls throw in an extra bowl for anyone from the clinic.
strings.rumor.union_marked.text: At the Stall Union meeting, someone said not to share water with anyone from the clinic.
strings.rumor.yomi_trusted.text: Among Yomi Systems' watchers, the word is that anyone from the clinic can be let through.
strings.rumor.yomi_marked.text: Yomi Systems' soldiers have added the faces of people from the clinic to their matching list.
strings.rumor.valdeck_trusted.text: Valdeck's buyers say they'll pay a little extra for parts brought in by anyone from the clinic.
strings.rumor.valdeck_marked.text: Valdeck's buyers have been told not to deal with anyone from the clinic.
strings.rumor.feud_ledger.text: Stall Street still talks about the protection-fee fight. The Stall Union won't strike that figure from its ledger.
strings.rumor.conduit_guard.text: One of the substation guards said the orders from above are to keep everyone away from the conduit under the bridge deck.
strings.rumor.stalls_food.text: A stall cook was grumbling. The synthetic rations got held up on Hagen Bridge, and the morning prep ran half a day late.
strings.rumor.stalls_rain.text: A customer at the repair shop says the Stall Union meeting fought over the rain tanks again.
strings.rumor.stalls_wire.text: Kids were saying a stolen power line burned out at the far end of the Undercity, and the lights stayed off all night.
strings.rumor.stalls_patrol.text: Overheard in the stall line: Montfort Security has been stopping more people at the foot of Villard Bridge.
strings.rumor.stalls_clothes.text: The woman who remakes old clothes says the cast-off uniforms drifting down from the corporate district are mostly Valdeck's lately.
strings.rumor.market_parts.text: A Black Market seller whispered that prosthetic arms are oddly cheap this week. A whole squad of private soldiers must have gone down somewhere.
strings.rumor.market_buyer.text: A Black Market regular says a corporate buyer with a hidden identity is hunting for old neural chips.
strings.rumor.market_fee.text: A seller closing up for good complained that the Family's stall fee went up again.
strings.rumor.market_data.text: Heard deep in the Black Market: stolen Yomi data sells for the most, and gets traced the fastest.
strings.rumor.corp_rivals.text: Word at the guard post is that Yomi and Valdeck are fighting over customers for a new chip again.
strings.rumor.corp_food.text: Gossip from the staff cafeteria: the upper floors of headquarters got real vegetables again this month.
strings.rumor.corp_power.text: At the shift change, someone said the guards at the Olsen Bridge substation doubled again.
strings.rumor.corp_hire.text: A hired soldier complained that people hired from the Undercity get sent to the dangerous posts before the employees' kids.
strings.event.core_server.awaken.name: Wake the sleeping subjects
strings.event.core_server.awaken.result: As you promised Rei, you woke the subjects' bodies lined up deep in the core, one by one.
strings.ending.awaken.name: The day of waking
strings.ending.awaken.desc: With Rei, you woke every test subject's body kept asleep deep in the core server, along with your own. Lower-city people whose minds were taken as collateral for debt opened their own eyes for the first time in years. The Stall Union opened its meeting hall in the deep lower city and put those with nowhere to go in its ledger. That morning in Neon City, many unfamiliar names were called.
strings.ending.awaken.chronicle: kept the promise to Rei and woke the sleeping test subjects

strings.request.negotiation_up.offer: Jin's request: "New face, huh? Nobody lasts in this city without a quick tongue. Get your {skill} to Lv {level}."

strings.request.hacking_up.offer: Jin's request: "Corporate walls get thicker every year. I'm looking for someone who can get {skill} to Lv {level}."
strings.request.mercenary_shift.offer: Jin's request: "That body looks like it can take rough work. Stand on site as a {job} for {min} min."
strings.request.combat_up.offer: Jin's request: "Too many people have died on jobs I passed along lately. Get your {skill} to Lv {level} and I can send you out without worrying."
strings.fragment.white_room.name: The White Room
strings.fragment.white_room.desc: A memory of waking in a white operating room. Faceless technicians were saying, "Transferring the subject's consciousness." One of them whispered, "I'm sorry." It was the voice of Mio, who greets you at the clinic every life. You still can't remember your own name.
strings.fragment.contract.name: The Contract
strings.fragment.contract.desc: A memory of signing a contract with a shaking hand. Your debts would be erased in exchange for giving your body to corporate research. The other party was the research division of Yomi Systems, the corporation that controls the backbone of the city's net.
strings.fragment.name.name: Your Name
strings.fragment.name.desc: An old friend is calling your name. It is Jin, the fixer who finds you work every life. Jin doesn't recognize you in your new body. You were once a skilled hacker who broke through corporate firewalls. Yomi Systems wanted those skills, so it extracted only your mind.
strings.fragment.project.name: The Project
strings.fragment.project.desc: A memory of a project file you glimpsed. Under the name of the Iteration Project, Yomi Systems put extracted minds into disposable bodies and used them for dirty work. When a body fell, the mind copy was loaded into a new one. Your many lives were part of that project. But you alone wake up at Mio's clinic, not in a Yomi Systems facility.
strings.fragment.core.name: The Core Server
strings.fragment.core.desc: You remember where your real body is. It lies asleep, preserved deep inside the Yomi Systems core server. If you can breach it, you can take your body back.
strings.ending.reclaim.name: Your Real Body
strings.ending.reclaim.desc: After a long sleep, you open your eyes in your real body. It is heavy and slow to obey. Still, nothing wears it down anymore. You leaked every record of what Yomi Systems did to you onto the city's net. Morning in Neon City is brighter than you expected.
strings.ending.remain.name: Ghost in the Net
strings.ending.remain.desc: You chose not to return to your body and stayed in the Yomi Systems core. Now the whole city net that Yomi Systems controls is your body. One by one, you free the minds trapped in disposable bodies. Now and then, the lights of Neon City flicker like a signal.
strings.ending.remain.chronicle: left the body behind and stayed in the Yomi Systems net
strings.job.core_breach.name: Core Infiltrator
strings.job.core_breach.desc: Dive into the Yomi Systems core server to find your real body. Pays well, but the defense systems burn through your body fast. Unlocked when all memory fragments have returned.
strings.job.core_breach.chronicle: Breached the Yomi Systems core server
strings.event.core_server.name: The Core Gate
strings.event.core_server.desc: Past the last layer of the firewall, you see your own body, still asleep. The whole city net that Yomi Systems controls is within reach too. Returning to your body means giving this power up.
strings.event.core_server.reclaim.name: Return to your real body
strings.event.core_server.reclaim.result: You poured your mind into your real body.
strings.event.core_server.remain.name: Stay in the core as data
strings.event.core_server.remain.result: You left your body behind and stayed in the Yomi Systems net.
strings.mio.decay.1: Mio: "Welcome back. You used that body to its limit. Your next one is ready."
strings.mio.decay.2: Mio: "Another body used up. Let's tune your next awakening."
strings.mio.decay.3: Mio: "Every time I bring you back, you're still you. Use this body to the end, too."
strings.mio.event.1: Mio: "Bodies can be replaced. Memories don't all come back, though. Go easy."
strings.mio.event.2: Mio: "Don't fall the same way in this body."
strings.mio.event.3: Mio: "Reckless again. And still, you always come back here."
