strings.profile.city.name: Neon City
strings.profile.city.desc: A future city divided and ruled by a few giant corporations. It is split between the Corporate District, lined with corporate towers, and the Undercity spread out beneath it. A corporation can be your client or your enemy.
strings.profile.city.project: The research division of Yomi Systems runs the Iteration Project. It puts extracted minds into disposable bodies for dirty work, and when a body falls, loads the mind copy into a new one.
strings.profile.city.subjects: The Iteration Project's subjects are skilled Undercity people who could no longer pay their debts. Yomi Systems, hiding its identity, buys their debts from the Zander Family on the black market, and the Family has each one sign a contract that wipes the debt in exchange for their body. Nobody with a company ID is made a subject.
strings.profile.city.core: At the center of the Yomi Systems network is the core server. The subjects' mind copies are kept there, and so is your real body.
strings.profile.history.name: City History
strings.profile.history.desc: Before the corporations divided it up, Neon City was governed by a city council and a city hall. The city stood on the high ground, and below the cliff lay wet, low land along a river. The city straightened the river into a drainage canal and built housing for factory workers on the dried-out low land. The three bridges between the high ground and the low land were built by the city engineer Olsen and Olsen's apprentices, Villard and Hagen. The bridges are still called by the names of the engineers who built them. The power plant, the water purification plant and the streetcars all belonged to the city. In time, the city could no longer pay its debts. To pay them, it sold the power plant to Yomi Systems, the water purification plant to Lindholm Foods, and the land on the high ground to the corporations. City hall closed, and the streetcars stopped when no one would buy them. No corporation bought the bridges, because they cost too much to maintain. With no landlord left, the housing on the low land fell apart, and the people who stayed settled in the ruins. That is today's Undercity.
strings.profile.engineers.name: The bridge engineers
strings.profile.engineers.desc: The three bridges of Neon City were built by city engineers in the days of the city. Olsen built the first, and his apprentices Villard and Hagen built the other two from their master's drawings. Their names are still on the plaques at the bridgeheads.
strings.profile.engineers.blueprints: The blueprints in the city archive copy carry Villard's notes. He wrote that he built the bridge without changing a single line of his master's drawing. The drawings show a thick conduit running under the bridge deck.
strings.profile.engineers.substation: The substation at the foot of the Olsen bridge was designed by Olsen along with the bridge. Power from the plant runs up to the high ground through the conduit under the deck.
strings.profile.engineers.core: The conduit Olsen laid now leads to the basement of Yomi Systems headquarters. The power that runs the core server still travels along the line a city engineer drew.
strings.profile.companies.name: Corporations
strings.profile.companies.desc: Neon City is divided and ruled by a few giant corporations. Yomi Systems sells neural interface chips and the backbone of the city's net, Waldeck Prosthetics sells prosthetic bodies and implants, and the two fight over chip customers. Lindholm Foods makes most of what the city eats, as synthetic food. The corporations are not equal in power: Yomi Systems, which holds the power and the net, and Lindholm Foods, which holds food and water, are the strongest. Each corporation guards its own turf with its own private soldiers. Montfort Security keeps order on the bridges and in the Undercity, which no corporation owns, paid for jointly by all of them. Each corporation also builds its own weapons as an extension of its products: Yomi Systems makes weapons that burn nerves over the net, Waldeck Prosthetics makes combat bodies with built-in weapons, Montfort Security makes guns and armor for its own forces, and Lindholm Foods makes poisons grown in its vats. Yomi Systems generates the city's electricity at its power plant and sends it across the city over its grid. Lindholm Foods purifies the water, at a plant it keeps for its vats.
strings.profile.food_company.name: Lindholm Foods
strings.profile.food_company.desc: A corporation that makes and sells synthetic food. In vats at factories on its own turf, it grows blocks of food from algae and cultured meat and supplies most of the shops in the city. The rations the Undercity food stalls stew and grill are this company's too. Real meat and vegetables only reach the Corporate District, and Undercity residents almost never taste them.
strings.profile.corp_district.name: Corporate District
strings.profile.corp_district.desc: A district lined with corporate towers. Each corporation holds its own turf, guarded by its own private soldiers. Three bridges link it to the Undercity: Olsen Bridge, Villard Bridge and Hagen Bridge. They span the drainage canal at the foot of the cliff. City engineers built them before the corporations divided up the city, and each is named after the engineer who built it. Montfort Security now watches them all. Most mercenary work happens here. Employees and private soldiers wear their own corporation's uniforms and live in company housing inside its turf. This is the only district where real meat and vegetables are eaten. It is also the only district with running water. The city has no public transit, and employees ride in their own corporation's cars.
strings.profile.lower_city.name: Undercity
strings.profile.lower_city.desc: A sunless city spread out beneath the towers of the Corporate District. Residents who belong to no corporation make a living running food stalls and repair shops. They live in shacks and containers stacked at the feet of the towers and under the bridges, and no one is their landlord. Their clothes are castoffs and synthetic fabric drifted down from the Corporate District, remade to fit. The food stalls stew and grill Lindholm Foods synthetic rations. The back-alley clinic is here, and so are the alleys couriers run through. Packs of thugs the residents scorn as ticks and hyenas hang around the alleys and take money from anyone passing. The Back Alleys and the Black Market are run by a gang called the Zander Family, and the shops on Food Stall Street pay it protection money through the Stall Union. Power comes in through the substation at the foot of Olsen Bridge, but most residents tap the grid with lines of their own. There is no running water; residents collect and filter rain, or buy clean water at the stalls. They get around on foot or by bike, and couriers carry the cargo.
strings.profile.black_market.name: Black Market
strings.profile.black_market.desc: A market under the Undercity where stolen data, body parts, and implants change hands. Corporate buyers come and go here too, hiding who they are. The Back Alleys, where the entrance is, are run by the Zander Family, and everyone who buys or sells pays the Family a stall fee.
strings.profile.zander.name: Zander Family
strings.profile.zander.desc: The gang that runs the Back Alleys and the Black Market, called by the name of the family at its head. The only entrance to the Black Market is in the Back Alleys, so the Family holds it and takes a stall fee from everyone who buys or sells inside. It also takes protection money from the shops on Food Stall Street. The corporations hand the Family the Undercity jobs they cannot be seen doing, by way of the Black Market. Anyone who settles in the Back Alleys pays the Family too. Montfort Security takes the Family's money and looks the other way at its business in the Back Alleys. The alley thugs are not part of the Family, but they back down when its name is dropped. The head and senior members all come from the head family's bloodline. The people working under them are gathered from outside: tough or daring youths raised in the Back Alleys, people who can't pay back what they owe the Family, and fired private soldiers hired as muscle.
strings.profile.union.name: Stall Union
strings.profile.union.desc: A self-governing group of the food stalls and repair shops on Food Stall Street and at the Far End of the Undercity. It decides how the rainwater tanks and clean water are shared and where the stolen power lines run, and it settles quarrels between residents. It pays the Zander Family's protection money for all the shops at once instead of shop by shop, and bargains with the Family over the amount. Everyone who opens a shop on Food Stall Street goes in the Union's ledger, and the Union splits the amount by each shop's spot and size. When someone from outside settles here, the Union assigns them an empty spot and gives them a share of water and power.
strings.profile.residents.name: How People Live
strings.profile.residents.desc: The Corporate District is home to corporate executives, employees and private soldiers, and each of them holds a corporate identity issued by their corporation. Executives are promoted from among the employees and live on the upper floors of the headquarters towers. Most employees are the children of employees, born and raised in company housing. Private soldiers come from employees' children and from people hired out of the Undercity. Being hired as a private soldier is the only way up from the Undercity. Going the other way, employees and private soldiers who are fired have their corporate identities erased, are thrown out of company housing, and move down to the Undercity. Most Undercity residents without a shop get by as day laborers, crossing a bridge each morning to do menial work in corporate plants, or as scavengers, picking up scrap and parts that drift down from the Corporate District and selling them. Identities are registered on the Yomi Systems network, and credits move through the account tied to each identity. Most Undercity residents who get paid in credits use fake identities that hackers make and sell on the Black Market. Montfort Security checks identities on the bridges, so anyone without one can't cross. The city has no courts. Inside a turf, that corporation's private soldiers hand out the punishment. On the bridges and in the Undercity, Montfort Security makes people pay fines and sends anyone who can't pay back down to the Undercity.
strings.profile.life_course.name: From Birth to Death
strings.profile.life_course.desc: Children in the Corporate District are born in company hospitals, study at company schools, and become employees or private soldiers. The Undercity has no schools; children learn a trade by working beside their parents or a master who runs a stall or repair shop. The Stall Union places orphans with shops, but those with no place to go become scavengers, and some of them end up as alley thugs. Company hospitals treat only people with a corporate identity. In the Undercity, back-alley doctors treat anyone who can pay, and medicine is bought at stalls or on the Black Market. People who retire from a corporation live in the company housing of a child who is an employee. Without such a child, their corporate identity is erased and they move down to the Undercity. Old people in the Undercity are supported by family or apprentices, and the Stall Union shares synthetic food and water with those who have no one. When an employee dies, the corporation burns the body and takes back the implants it had lent. When an Undercity resident dies, the family carries the body to a back-alley doctor, who removes the implants and usable organs, pays the family, and sells them on the Black Market. Almost all body parts on the Black Market come from there. The rest is burned at the Stall Union's crematorium in the Far End, and the ashes are washed into the drainage canal. When someone dies in debt, the Zander Family takes the body.
strings.profile.self.name: Yourself
strings.profile.self.desc: Every time your body falls, you wake up in a new one at the back-alley clinic. The skills you trained and the credits you earned don't carry over to the next body. You can't remember your past, or even your own name.
strings.profile.self.contract: You signed a contract giving your body to the research division of Yomi Systems in exchange for erasing your debts.
strings.profile.self.hacker: You were once a skilled hacker who broke through corporate firewalls. Yomi Systems wanted those skills, so it extracted only your mind.
strings.profile.self.project: You are one of the Iteration Project's subjects. But you alone wake up at Mio's clinic, not in a Yomi Systems facility.
strings.profile.self.core: Your real body lies asleep, preserved deep inside the Yomi Systems core server.
strings.profile.mio.name: Mio
strings.profile.mio.desc: A street doctor at the back-alley clinic. Every time your body falls, Mio greets you in your new one. Mio remembers you from past lives, whatever body you are in. Each life's body is one Mio assembles from body parts bought on the black market. The parts are paid for with the 10% cut Mio keeps from your earnings.
strings.profile.mio.white_room: Mio was one of the technicians who transferred your mind in the white operating room. The one who whispered "I'm sorry" was Mio.
strings.profile.mio.project: Subjects normally wake up in a Yomi Systems facility. You wake up at the clinic because Mio rewrote where your mind copy is loaded.
strings.profile.jin.name: Jin
strings.profile.jin.desc: The fixer who finds you work. Your body is different every life, so Jin always talks to you as a stranger.
strings.profile.jin.old_friend: An old friend who used to call you by name. Jin can't tell it's you in your new body.
strings.profile.rei.name: Rei
strings.profile.rei.desc: A hacker who called out to you from beyond the firewall. Rei is a subject whose mind is used by the same program as yours, and remembers past lives too.
strings.profile.rei.origin: Rei is an Undercity hacker who became a subject by signing the same debt contract. Subjects have their memories of past lives sealed each time they wake, but Rei used her hacking skill to break her own seal from the inside.
strings.profile.rei.list: Rei is trying to steal the list of subjects from a corporate vault, and asked for your help.
strings.ui.part_two_enter: Go on to Part Two: live in your true body
strings.ui.part_two_enter_note: What happens after you wake in your true body. There is no rebirth: you keep one body and rebuild your life. You can come back to this screen at any time.
strings.ui.true_body: True body: no rebirth. Condition drops while you work and comes back while you rest. Injuries lower your maximum condition until the clinic treats them.
strings.ui.treat: Have Mio treat your injuries (injury -{n}, {cost} credits)
strings.ui.room_note: With a room, rest restores condition twice as fast. Rent is {rent} credits a day.
strings.ui.chapter_next: The rest of Part Two is still in the works.
strings.log.part_two_start: You woke from a long sleep in your true body. Your fingers are clumsy and your head is still foggy.
strings.log.part_two_back: You returned to day {day} of Part Two.
strings.log.condition_low: Your body feels heavy. Rest soon, or you will collapse.
strings.log.street_night: You could not pay for a bed and spent the night on the street.
strings.log.collapse: You collapsed on the job and were carried to the back-alley clinic. Treatment cost {n} credits and a day in bed.
strings.log.treated: Mio treated your injuries. Injury left: {n}
strings.log.room: You rented a small room deep in the lower city.
strings.chapter.heavy_body.name: A Heavy Body
strings.chapter.heavy_body.desc: Get used to the body you just took back, and rebuild a life in the lower city.
strings.chapter.heavy_body.goal.steady: Get all three skills to Lv 15
strings.event.p2_wake.name: Your True Body
strings.event.p2_wake.desc: You wake on a cot in the back-alley clinic. Mio takes your pulse. "This body slept a long time. It won't move the way you want for a while, and your skills will come back when your fingers and your head remember. There are no spare bodies now, so don't push it."
strings.event.p2_wake.slowly.name: Get used to it slowly
strings.event.p2_wake.slowly.result: Mio smiled. "Rest when you're tired. That's all I ask."
strings.event.p2_wake.ask.name: Ask what to do next
strings.event.p2_wake.ask.result: "Go show Jin your face," Mio said. "Your real face, this time."
strings.event.p2_jin.name: A Familiar Face
strings.event.p2_jin.desc: When you come for work, Jin stops and stares at your face. "...You're alive? I heard Yomi Systems erased you years ago."
strings.event.p2_jin.tell.name: Tell the truth
strings.event.p2_jin.tell.result: You told him you had met him many times in other bodies. Jin was quiet for a long while. "So that's why the new couriers' tricks felt familiar."
strings.event.p2_jin.deny.name: Say he has the wrong person
strings.event.p2_jin.deny.result: "Have it your way," Jin said, and handed you a job slip.
strings.event.p2_hunters.name: Hunters
strings.event.p2_hunters.desc: Hunters are asking around the lower city for whoever leaked Yomi Systems' records onto the city net. A stranger was standing near your new room, too.
strings.event.p2_hunters.fall: collapsed while hiding from the hunters
strings.event.p2_hunters.hide.name: Stay in your room until they pass
strings.event.p2_hunters.hide.result: You held your breath for two nights. The hunters moved on to the next street.
strings.event.p2_hunters.pay.name: Pay the neighbors to keep quiet
strings.event.p2_hunters.pay.result: The stall owners took the money and said they had never seen your face.
strings.event.p2_hunters.mislead.name: Spread a false trail
strings.event.p2_hunters.mislead.result: You spread a rumor that the leaker fled across the bridge. The hunters left the lower city that same day.
strings.event.p2_hunters.mislead.voice: Feed the hunters the story they most want to believe.
strings.event.p2_heavy_body_end.name: Your Own Body
strings.event.p2_heavy_body_end.desc: One morning in your rented room, your body finally feels like your own. On the way home from work, Jin lowers his voice. "There's a way to get your name back. The records of your erased identity must still be out there."
strings.event.p2_heavy_body_end.listen.name: Hear Jin out
strings.event.p2_heavy_body_end.listen.result: Jin named a few old friends. Nobody knows if they are still alive.
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.name: Shaking Hands
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.desc: Running with a package leaves you out of breath fast. The speed of your borrowed bodies is gone.
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.fall: collapsed while running with a package
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.push.name: Push yourself and hurry
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.push.result: You made it, but twisted your ankle a little.
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.slow.name: Walk at your own pace
strings.event.p2_shaking_hands.slow.result: You arrived late, but learned a bit about how this body moves.
strings.event.p2_lost_code.name: A Forgotten Routine
strings.event.p2_lost_code.desc: An intrusion routine you used to type with your eyes closed stops halfway in your head. Your mind feels foggy.
strings.event.p2_lost_code.fall: collapsed while typing a routine you could not remember
strings.event.p2_lost_code.guess.name: Type it from instinct
strings.event.p2_lost_code.guess.result: It got through, but you stayed up all night dodging alarms.
strings.event.p2_lost_code.relearn.name: Rebuild it from scratch
strings.event.p2_lost_code.relearn.result: It took time, but the rebuilt routine was shorter than before.
strings.event.p2_lost_code.recall.name: Let your fingers do it
strings.event.p2_lost_code.recall.result: When you stopped thinking, your fingers typed the rest on their own.
strings.event.p2_lost_code.recall.voice: Don't think. These fingers have opened this hole many times.
strings.event.p2_one_body.name: No Spare Body
strings.event.p2_one_body.desc: A firefight starts. In the old bodies, falling meant waking in the next one. If this body gets shot, that's the end.
strings.event.p2_one_body.charge.name: Move in and finish it
strings.event.p2_one_body.charge.result: You finished it, but a bullet grazed your shoulder.
strings.event.p2_one_body.cover.name: Give cover from behind
strings.event.p2_one_body.cover.result: You fired back from cover and waited for the others to finish.
strings.event.p2_one_body.read.name: Read their moves
strings.event.p2_one_body.read.result: You saw their timing. Not a single bullet hit you.
strings.event.p2_one_body.read.voice: They always pull back the right shoulder before they shoot.
strings.chapter.heavy_body.goal.debt.paid: You paid Mio for all the treatment she gave you.
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.name: What You Owe Mio
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.desc: When you hold out the credits, Mio does not take them for a while. "Every time you fell, I was here with a new body, waiting. Dozens of times. That's not something money pays back." In the end, she takes them without a word.
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.thank.name: Thank her
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.thank.result: Mio looked away. "Next time, come before you fall."
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.ask_why.name: Ask why she helped you
strings.event.p2_mio_debt.ask_why.result: "Maybe someone rewrote my load target once, too," Mio laughed. She said nothing more.
strings.ui.ally_note: Click to change the job you leave to {ally}. {ally} now earns {n} credits per second and keeps {pct}% as a cut.
strings.ally.saki.name: Saki
strings.ally.saki.desc: The old crew's courier. These days she hauls cargo for the stall union.
strings.ally.gou.name: Gou
strings.ally.gou.desc: The old crew's muscle. Kept fighting in betting matches to pay off a debt.
strings.ally.towa.name: Towa
strings.ally.towa.desc: A young hacker you once taught. Kept studying the archive's firewall alone.
strings.chapter.name.name: A Name
strings.chapter.name.desc: Find your old crew one by one to win back the name and identity that were erased.
strings.chapter.name.goal.muscle.paid: You paid off Gou's debt to the match bookie.
strings.chapter.name.goal.vault: Buy a way into the archive
strings.chapter.name.goal.vault.paid: You bought the archive's guard rota and a cleaning crew's pass.
strings.event.p2_crew.name: The Old Crew
strings.event.p2_crew.desc: Jin named three people from the old crew. Saki the courier, Gou the muscle, and Towa, the one you taught. "After you vanished, everyone scattered. The records of your erased identity sit in Yomi Systems' archive. You can't get in alone."
strings.event.p2_crew.ask_each.name: Look for them one by one
strings.event.p2_crew.ask_each.result: You start with Saki, who is said to haul cargo for the stall union.
strings.event.p2_crew.ask_jin.name: Get their whereabouts out of Jin
strings.event.p2_crew.ask_jin.result: Jin frowned and handed you a note with the three's last known places. "It's all old news."
strings.event.p2_saki.name: Saki the Courier
strings.event.p2_saki.desc: Saki turned around in front of the union's cart. "I remember the face. But you're supposed to be dead. I'm not idle enough to work for a dead man." Still, as you kept talking, she set the cargo down without a word.
strings.event.p2_saki.ask.name: Talk about the old days and ask
strings.event.p2_saki.ask.result: "Hauling is the same as before," Saki said. "And I'll take my cut, every credit."
strings.event.p2_saki.ride.name: Push the cart with her and ask
strings.event.p2_saki.ride.result: When you pushed the cart up the slope, Saki laughed. "With those legs, you're no courier anymore. I'll do the hauling."
strings.event.p2_gou.name: Gou the Muscle
strings.event.p2_gou.desc: When you paid the match bookie, Gou came out of the back room. His knuckles had more scars than before. "I pay my debts. I'll stick with you until you get your identity back."
strings.event.p2_gou.shake.name: Offer your hand
strings.event.p2_gou.shake.result: Gou shook it with his big hand. "Send the mercenary work my way."
strings.event.p2_gou.spar.name: Ask him to test you
strings.event.p2_gou.spar.result: He put you on the floor three times. "The body's gone dull," Gou said, "but the eyes are still alive."
strings.event.p2_towa.name: Towa the Student
strings.event.p2_towa.desc: You left a signal on an old board the way you used to, and an answer came at once. The young hacker who came to meet you spread out a map of the archive's firewall. "Ever since you vanished, this is the one thing I kept studying. I couldn't break it alone."
strings.event.p2_towa.show.name: Read the map together
strings.event.p2_towa.show.result: As you traced the map, your fingers remembered the old routine. "It really is you," Towa said.
strings.event.p2_towa.teach.name: Teach the way through
strings.event.p2_towa.teach.result: When you pointed out three holes on the map, Towa was quiet for a long time. "This is what I've been looking for."
strings.event.p2_towa.teach.voice: A firewall opens along the habits of whoever built it.
strings.event.p2_name_end.name: A Name
strings.event.p2_name_end.desc: Before dawn, Saki's cart brought you to the archive's back door. Gou kept watch while you and Towa broke the firewall. The records of your erased identity were still there, deep in the archive, marked for deletion.
strings.event.p2_name_end.read.name: Open the record
strings.event.p2_name_end.read.result: The name field held the name Jin used to call you. You wrote the record back into the city's net, and your crew called you by that name.
strings.event.p2_saki.fall: You collapsed while pushing the cart
strings.event.p2_gou.fall: You collapsed while Gou tested you
strings.ui.hidden_note: While a bed is free, a subject escapes to you every 2 days. Each sheltered subject helps at the stalls for 3 credits per second and eats 30 credits a day.
strings.log.base: Your hideout in the depths of the lower city is ready.
strings.log.subject: A subject escaped from a Recurrence Project facility. You now shelter {n}.
strings.facility.bed.name: Beds
strings.facility.bed.desc: Each level shelters 2 more people, up to 3 levels. Resting in a bed restores condition 3 times as fast.
strings.facility.clinic.name: Clinic
strings.facility.clinic.desc: A table Mio uses when she visits. Your injuries heal slowly while you rest.
strings.facility.workshop.name: Workshop
strings.facility.workshop.desc: Where your crew keeps their gear. Their cut drops to 20%.
strings.facility.wire.name: Power tap
strings.facility.wire.desc: Power drawn from the stall union's line. Your daily living cost becomes just the food for the subjects you shelter.
strings.chapter.shelter.name: Hideout
strings.chapter.shelter.desc: Team up with the stall union to build a hideout in the lower city, and shelter subjects who fled the Recurrence Project.
strings.chapter.shelter.goal.place: Get a place in the union's ledger
strings.chapter.shelter.goal.place.paid: You paid the union, and an old water tank in the depths of the lower city went into its ledger.
strings.event.p2_union.name: The Union's Request
strings.event.p2_union.desc: A stall union steward came to the back-alley clinic. "People who fled the Recurrence Project, still in their disposable bodies, are hiding among the stalls. The hunters search our shops too. If they're after you as well, will you help us build a hiding place?"
strings.event.p2_union.agree.name: Agree
strings.event.p2_union.agree.result: The steward said there's an empty spot deep in the lower city. Getting it into the ledger takes a payment to the union.
strings.event.p2_union.terms.name: Settle the terms
strings.event.p2_union.terms.result: You agreed that anyone you shelter helps at the stalls. The steward promised the union would share water and power.
strings.event.p2_shelter.name: The Old Water Tank
strings.event.p2_shelter.desc: The union's ledger now lists an old water tank in the depths of the lower city. It's roomy inside, with a single entrance. The hunters will have a hard time finding it.
strings.event.p2_shelter.build.name: Turn the tank into a hideout
strings.event.p2_shelter.build.result: You laid a floor and leaned an old sign over the entrance. Add beds and you can shelter those who fled.
strings.event.p2_shelter.hide_deep.name: Dig a passage out the back
strings.event.p2_shelter.hide_deep.result: You cleared the rubble and opened a narrow passage out the back. Your shoulder aches, but now there's a way out.
strings.event.p2_raid.name: Wanted Posters
strings.event.p2_raid.desc: Late at night, Yomi Systems' hunters began walking the stall street with wanted posters. They're two alleys from the hideout.
strings.event.p2_raid.fight.name: Ambush them in the alley
strings.event.p2_raid.fight.result: You waited deep in the alley and put all three hunters down. Everything hurts, but the hideout stayed hidden.
strings.event.p2_raid.lure.name: Draw them off with a rumor
strings.event.p2_raid.lure.result: You told the stall customers the runaways headed for the bridge. The hunters left for the bridge that same night.
strings.event.p2_raid.jam.name: Hijack their terminal
strings.event.p2_raid.jam.result: You got into the hunters' terminal and swapped the poster photos for strangers. They went home searching for the wrong faces.
strings.event.p2_runaway.name: The One Who Fled
strings.event.p2_runaway.desc: The night all six beds were ready, the newest subject started talking about the facility. "There, we couldn't even sleep without an order. I don't know how many years this body has left."
strings.event.p2_runaway.listen.name: Listen quietly
strings.event.p2_runaway.listen.result: When the story was done, the subject curled up in a bed and slept.
strings.event.p2_runaway.ask_body.name: Ask about what comes next
strings.event.p2_runaway.ask_body.result: After a moment, the subject said they want to help at the stalls. "It's the first time I get to choose my own work."
strings.event.p2_shelter_end.name: Hideout
strings.event.p2_shelter_end.desc: Every bed is taken. The steward promised to keep the hideout listed as an empty warehouse. That night, Towa brought back something strange from the hunters' comms. "Boss, the research division took a copy out of the central server. The tag has your number on it."
strings.event.p2_shelter_end.look.name: Read the comm logs
strings.event.p2_shelter_end.look.result: At the end of the log was a date for loading the copy into a new body. Another you is about to wake up somewhere.
strings.event.p2_raid.lure.voice: Hunters want a story shaped like a lead.
strings.event.p2_raid.jam.voice: A wanted poster is just one picture on a terminal.
